title: n8n
tagline: Workflow automation with starter workflows for LightRAG, Neo4j, search and GPT Researcher
description: Runs n8n with starter workflows, plus the GPT Researcher API (gpt-researcher) that one of them calls. n8n-import loads the workflows and generates n8n's demo credentials on first start, when n8n_storage has no database yet. The workflows reach LightRAG and Neo4j when those add-ons are on. No Hermes tool reaches n8n, and the separate gptr-mcp service of the GPT Researcher add-on is not touched. Disabling keeps n8n_storage and gptr_outputs. remove --delete-data deletes the workflows, credentials and execution history in n8n_storage and the reports in gptr_outputs. Back up N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY: without it the stored credentials cannot be decrypted.
postInstallMessage: Open http://localhost:5678 and create the owner account.
